text:
Sophie: Quick async check — INC-847 postmortem action list looks messy. A few items unassigned or conflicting. Can we lock owners + due dates by EOD Fri? I pasted the current action table below (link) — please ack and update.

Sophie: ```
Item | Owner | Due
DB migration rollback test | (unassigned) | -
Canary cutover plan | (unassigned) | -
Alerting playbook update | (unassigned) | -
Telemetry validation | (unassigned) | -
Customer comms template | (unassigned) | -
Postmortem writeup | (unassigned) | -
```

incident-bot: incident-bot created postmortem INC-847 and synced actions to the tracker.

Ryan: I'll take "DB migration rollback test" — target Thu noon UTC. Will add checklist to the PR and mark in the tracker.

Maria: Thanks — I'll be backup for DB rollback and can help with test infra if Ryan needs extra capacity.

Tom: I can own "Canary cutover plan" but need Eng-Infra support for capacity windows. Tentative ETA Mon 2024-06-17. @infra-oncall can you confirm available slots?

Priya: I'll own "Alerting playbook update" + pager threshold tuning. Plan to ship Fri 2024-06-14. I'll add runbook snippets and a short test plan.

Carla: I'll validate telemetry/KPI gating for rollback and build the e2e checks. Need sample traces from prod (last 72h). @SRE can you export traces and drop link?

Sophie: Thanks — updated the tracker with preliminary owners where folks volunteered. Still missing: "Customer comms template" and "Postmortem writeup". Who can take those?

Maria: I can draft the customer comms template. ETA Fri EOD. I'll use the comms boilerplate in /docs/incident-templates and link back here.

Tom: I'll take the postmortem writeup and stitch the tech timeline. Will coordinate with Maria for comms wording. ETA Mon 2024-06-17.

Sophie: Final ask: if you pick an ETA, put it into the spreadsheet and add the JIRA tag #INC-847-action so the automation picks it up. Quick example to copy: `/assign INC-847 | DB-rollback | Ryan | 2024-06-13`

Priya: noted. Also flagging a dependency: canary plan depends on new test harness (ENG-1254). @Sophie can you escalate to Eng-Platform if we need extra headroom?

Sophie: Escalated to Eng-Platform and added ENG-1254 to the dependent row in the tracker. Pinged @eng-platform on the tracker.

incident-bot: Actions updated in tracker by Sophie; 7 items assigned or claimed.

Ryan: ack. I'll update the PR with the rollback checklist later today and tag Maria as backup.

Sophie: Thanks all — I'll do a quick follow-up tomorrow to confirm everything landed. :thumbsup:
